query_languages.name: other_explicitly_attested
query_languages.role: IQL, SQL-like query language over derived clusters; not asserted SQL

backend.source_model_description: Linked-data extraction from Freebase/DBpedia; HMatch2.0 matching, hierarchical agglomerative clustering, inCloud repository and HTML5/JavaScript client with caching. IQL operates on the cluster structure.

descriptions.interaction: Select similarity clusters, inspect their resources, follow neighbouring themes while retaining the thematic path; keyword search with completion/history; assisted SQL-like IQL editing.
descriptions.guidance: Representative cluster labels/types, similarity-based proximity links, prominence thresholds, suggested keywords and IQL inline help.
descriptions.visualisation: Cluster circles sized by prominence and proximity edges weighted by similarity; segmented neighbour navigation, resource details, thematic-path and query panels.
descriptions.backend: Linked-data extraction from Freebase/DBpedia; HMatch2.0 matching, hierarchical agglomerative clustering, inCloud repository and HTML5/JavaScript client with caching. IQL operates on the cluster structure.
descriptions.evaluation: System demonstration of two walk tasks on a celebrity dataset; no sampled participant study or controlled comparison reported.
descriptions.scalability: Demo dataset about2,900 resources,400classes and over4,000predicates; derived graph44clusters/368proximity links. Default13clusters versus full view. No measured latency/throughput benchmark.

resources.notes: Current GET evidence only. HTTP success is not proof of repository code, valid license, reproducible installation or working demo; source identity review is required.
